novel_features.name: Unanswered-post queue
novel_features.description: Surface every community post with zero replies, oldest first, so nothing goes unanswered.
novel_features.rationale: Filters live posts for zero comments via the Apify actor with a server-side age cutoff — no single native Skool call returns this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to find the exact posts a solo admin still owes a reply to, focused on the ones waiting longest.

novel_features.name: Inbox triage
novel_features.description: List exactly which chats are waiting on a reply from you.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-chat last-author + local read-state analysis the API can only answer one chat at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The fastest path to inbox-zero: only the chats where the member spoke last.

novel_features.name: Member onboarding funnel
novel_features.description: Track pending to approved to active conversion over time.
novel_features.rationale: Built from mirrored membership snapshots; the live API has no historical funnel view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to see how quickly applicants are being approved and where they stall.

novel_features.name: Posting cadence
novel_features.description: Visualize your posting rhythm over the last N weeks.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates historical post timestamps from the local mirror.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to keep a consistent content schedule.

novel_features.name: Daily standup digest
novel_features.description: One command: new members, unanswered posts, unread chats, recent activity.
novel_features.rationale: A cross-entity local join across posts, chats, and members that no single endpoint provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The single morning command that tells a solo admin what needs attention today.

narrative.headline: Run your whole Skool community from the terminal — posts, members, chats, webhooks — with a local SQLite mirror and offline analytics no other Skool tool has.
narrative.value_prop: skool unifies the SkoolAPI.com REST API and the Apify all-in-one actor behind one Go binary, then adds what neither has: a local mirror you can query with `sql`, full-text `search`, and compound commands like `digest today`, `post unanswered`, and `chat waiting`. Built for the solo admin who wants to spend time on content, not admin clicks — and drivable by Claude as an MCP server.
narrative.auth_narrative: Native commands use a SkoolAPI secret (`SKOOL_API_SECRET`) plus a session created from your Skool email and password; the session is cached locally and auto-refreshed. Admin/write commands (member approve/ban, course publish, Auto DM, group info) run through the Apify actor and need `APIFY_API_TOKEN`.

quickstart.comment: set your default community so commands don't need it each time
authenticate from SKOOL_EMAIL/SKOOL_PASSWORD and cache the active session
pull posts, chats, and members into the local SQLite mirror
see new members, unanswered posts, and unread chats at a glance

troubleshoots.fix: Run `skool-pp-cli session refresh` — Skool tokens expire ~yearly and on password change.
Confirm SKOOL_API_SECRET is set and the session is active; the edge blocks unauthenticated requests.
Set APIFY_API_TOKEN — member admin, course publish, Auto DM and group status route through the Apify actor.

narrative.when_to_use: Use skool when you manage a Skool community and want to script or delegate the repetitive admin: triaging chats, finding unanswered posts, approving member waves, publishing courses from markdown, and getting a daily digest. It is the right choice for agent-driven community ops because every command has structured output and the local mirror lets agents run compound queries offline.
